title: Independent proof: P112 three-call COPY192 via a sharp block count
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Independent proof / scoped negative result, no new κ.** Three independent P112 all-pairs calls retain sharp separate-total union-pairing cost **192**, even with a different arbitrary isometric binary label chart per call and free conversions. For every `0 < q <= 1`, the sharp power bill remains `24*8^q`.

The new six-order block-triangular argument proves `n + (2/3)p >= 24`, where `p` counts pure cross-call terms. Within-call terms cost at least eight; pure terms can genuinely cost seven. Hence the copy bill is at least `192 + (5/3)p`. An exact coupled identity attains the counting lemma, while the standard decoder attains COPY192.

Scope: any finite number of complex root-code factors, ordinary transpose, independent endpoint `C=I_3`, and the separate-total union-price objective. This does not cover arbitrary interacting circuits, outside-code factors, non-isometric own-call charts or four-call batches. Physical compiler, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain untouched; no selected supplier/frontier changes.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4.
- OS assignment seed **47**, structural decoder track; `centre-path-sharing` card refined to one copied-information proof obligation.
- Extends **PR #2294**, head `18d6ac4f864af2b71aa8cf5f4541fcfc4350e2f0`, from two calls to its explicitly open three-call case. Uses a new triangular deletion argument, not more chart sampling. Main's PR1714 support/model sources are SHA256/Git-blob pinned; no predecessor code is imported or vendored.
- Final overlap: 550 open PR bodies and 1,058 Discussions, complete pagination, no warnings, 05:54 UTC. Main and the PR2294 head were unchanged. Other three-mode hits concern coordinates within one call.
- [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18941767); scope, proof, source pins and evidence are in `research/p112-three-call-isometric-floor/`.

**Concurrent work discovered immediately before submission:** DreamingOfClouds' #2338, head `82700676e1d42acf98dc1921cb6ef82551620008`, §3.4 states a broader all-batch symmetric-chart floor using normal classes and an additional frame lemma. Our core proof/verifier was completed before reading it (commit `9df32e528da547a1c1cb51cbd480f88f8b7d197e`). This PR adds a different, frame-lemma-free three-call argument, a sharp counting certificate and full all-pairs/mutation evidence. Its scope and surplus bound are narrower; **no first-closure or stronger-floor claim**. The concurrent package has not been fully audited here.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-three-call-isometric-floor
```

Expected: `PASS_P112_THREE_CALL_ISOMETRIC_FLOOR`, `PASS_THREE_CALL_PACKAGE_CONTROLS`, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.13: registered optimized and direct normal replay pass. CPython 3.14.5 optimized output is byte-identical. Exact receipt SHA256: `c1278f0b9154e144fe67e85652c0b98c4bfd98b9c481a2680037a2b8efe08f09`.

Coverage: all 511 support functionals; 64 within-call and 64 cross-chart exceptional pairs; 12 support patterns × 6 orders; four full 336×336 endpoint fixtures; seven internal mathematical controls. Relocation/read-only checks and five on-disk corruptions pass. A four-call 2×2-support control catches the invalid extension of the deletion lemma. Metadata/pins and `git diff --check` pass. Finite replay supports the written proof; it is not formal verification of the full theorem. Selected cold replay and hosted CI are not claimed.

Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance drafting the proof, code and documentation; author-checked, no independent human review or proof-assistant check.

## Open next questions

The package's README and TASK.json give two bounded follow-ups. First classify balanced 2×2 pure supports for four calls: their mean truncation rank is one, so this proof no longer suffices. A physical escape would instead need a specified interacting-copy or outside-code interface with its complete preparation, restoration and recursive-child bill.
